Tenant Screening Checklist & Scorecard

Reduce tenant risk with a comprehensive 25-point scoring system. Assess credit history, employment, references, and rental behavior. Includes risk categorization and decision framework.

What's Included

  • 25-Point Scorecard: Comprehensive tenant assessment framework
  • Risk Categorization: Low, Medium, High risk classifications
  • Verification Checklist: Employment, income, references, criminal history, rental history
  • Fillable PDF: Print and fill by hand or complete digitally
  • Excel Workbook: Automated scoring and decision logic (Pro & Agency tiers)
  • Word Template: Customizable decision letter to tenant (Pro & Agency tiers)
  • Decision Page: Summary and recommendation based on score
  • WhatsApp Cards: 5 marketing cards (Agency tier only)
  • Offline-first: No subscriptions, no cloud required.

Assessment Categories

  • Employment & Income: Stable employment, income verification, debt-to-income ratio
  • Rental History: Previous landlord references, payment history, evictions
  • Credit Profile: Credit score, outstanding debts, judgments, defaults
  • Character & Background: Criminal history, character references, length of residence
  • Risk Classification: Green (approve), Yellow (caution), Red (reject/additional review)

Act 220 Compliant: Screening process aligns with Ghana's Rent Act, 1963 requirements for tenant selection and dispute prevention.
